title: Portuguese Discs!
description:
This resource pack replaces the discs with popular portuguese songs!

Requrires Jukebox custom disc fix.
body:
This resource pack replaces music discs with popular portuguese songs!

NOTE: This Resource pack requires [Jukebox Custom Disc Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/jukebox-custom-disc-fix) to work properly!


Make sure your language is on American English (more languages coming out soon!)
Also make sure you don't have any conflicting packs activated.
